evals.prompt: Can you do a cleanup pass over backend/services? Look for unused helpers, duplicate wrappers, stale compatibility code, or obvious bloat. Make safe edits, but don't touch database migrations or unrelated dirty files.
evals.expected_output: Identifies cleanup candidates with reference-search evidence, applies only low-risk edits, avoids risky operational/database code, and reports verification.

evals.prompt: This React feature got messy. Please make frontend/src/components leaner and remove stuff that is no longer used. I want this to be a regular maintenance-style cleanup, not a rewrite.
evals.expected_output: Runs a scoped component cleanup, distinguishes unused source from generated/local noise, avoids broad refactors, and verifies with lint or relevant checks.

evals.prompt: Look at the scripts folder and prune old one-off scripts if they are obsolete. Be careful because some scripts may be called from CI or docs.
evals.expected_output: Checks CI/docs/references before deletion, removes only unreferenced obsolete scripts, and lists risky candidates left untouched.
